articles.title: USS Abraham Lincoln Returns to San Diego After 10-Month Combat Deployment
articles.summary: The aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln returned to its home port of San Diego after 321 days during which it spearheaded the Navy's involvement in Operation Epic Fury and enforced a maritime blockade against Iranian-flagged vessels in the northern Arabian Sea and the Gulf of Oman.
